---
title: "Cohorts"
subtitle: "Eighteen consented collections, over 50,000 DNA samples, and the subset selected for sequencing"
---

Each member cohort was collected under its own ethics approval, and protocol amendments will be sought where needed for long-read sequencing. From the combined collections we select a representative subset: 1,000 genomes for long-read sequencing, 520 of them with single-cell PBMC profiles, and 122 gallbladder donors in Chile.

## Where the samples come from

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
cohorts = FileAttachment("data/cohorts.csv").csv({typed: true})
places = FileAttachment("data/countries.csv").csv({typed: true})
topojson = require("topojson-client@3")
world = d3.json("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/countries-110m.json")
land = topojson.feature(world, world.objects.countries)
partnerColor = new Map(places.map(d => [d.atlas_name, d.color]))
dark = document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof metric = Inputs.radio(
  new Map([
    ["Long-read genomes", "lr_wgs"],
    ["Single-cell PBMC profiles", "pbmc_scrna"],
    ["Gallbladder profiling", "gb_profiling"]
  ]),
  {value: "lr_wgs", label: "Show"}
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
totals = places.map(p => {
  const rows = cohorts.filter(d => d.country === p.country)
  return {...p, value: d3.sum(rows, d => d[metric] ?? 0), n: rows.length}
}).filter(d => d.value > 0)

Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 760),
  height: Math.min(width, 760) * 1.05,
  projection: {
    type: "mercator",
    domain: {type: "MultiPoint", coordinates: [[-112, 30], [-36, -55]]},
    inset: 8
  },
  r: {range: [0, 34], domain: [0, 220]},
  marks: [
    Plot.geo(land, {fill: dark ? "#1E2D45" : "#E4E9EF", stroke: dark ? "#0E1A2E" : "#FFFFFF", strokeWidth: 0.6}),
    Plot.geo(land.features.filter(f => partnerColor.has(f.properties.name)), {
      fill: f => partnerColor.get(f.properties.name), fillOpacity: 0.4,
      stroke: dark ? "#0E1A2E" : "#FFFFFF", strokeWidth: 0.6
    }),
    Plot.dot(totals, {
      x: "lon", y: "lat", r: "value",
      fill: "color", stroke: dark ? "#E6ECF3" : "#14233C", strokeWidth: 1.2,
      title: d => `${d.country}\n${d.value} samples from ${d.n} cohort${d.n > 1 ? "s" : ""}`
    }),
    Plot.text(totals, {
      // labels sit just right of each circle (offset in degrees, scaled with radius)
      x: d => d.lon + 0.8 + 3.6 * Math.sqrt(d.value / 220), y: "lat",
      text: d => `${d.country} ${d.value}`, textAnchor: "start",
      fill: "currentColor", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600,
      stroke: dark ? "#0E1A2E" : "#F7F9FB", strokeWidth: 3, paintOrder: "stroke"
    })
  ]
})
```

Circle area is proportional to the number of selected samples per country. Positions mark the country, not a specific community.

## All cohorts

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof country = Inputs.select(["All countries", ...new Set(cohorts.map(d => d.country))], {label: "Country"})
viewof query = Inputs.search(country === "All countries" ? cohorts : cohorts.filter(d => d.country === country),
  {placeholder: "Search cohorts, ancestries, data types or PIs"})
```

::: {.ojs-scroll}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(query, {
  columns: ["country", "cohort", "design", "recruitment", "ancestries", "available_samples", "available_data", "pis", "lr_wgs", "pbmc_scrna", "gb_profiling"],
  header: {
    country: "Country", cohort: "Cohort", design: "Sampling", recruitment: "Recruitment",
    ancestries: "Ancestries or localities", available_samples: "Available samples",
    available_data: "Existing data", pis: "PIs / collaborators",
    lr_wgs: "Long-read WGS", pbmc_scrna: "PBMC scRNA", gb_profiling: "Gallbladder"
  },
  format: {
    country: c => htl.html`<span><span class="dot" style="--k:${places.find(p => p.country === c)?.color}"></span>${c}</span>`,
    available_samples: d3.format(","),
    lr_wgs: v => v ?? "", pbmc_scrna: v => v ?? "", gb_profiling: v => v ?? ""
  },
  width: {ancestries: 220, pis: 240, available_data: 180},
  rows: 20,
  layout: "auto"
})
```
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Existing WGS data at member sites is short-read Illumina. Long-read genomes will be generated by PacBio, and single-cell RNA from PBMCs and gallbladder controls by the CZI-funded LatinCells project, both at no cost to this grant. Chile's gallbladder total includes 32 existing Mapuche controls and 90 new samples (45 cases, 45 controls).
:::
